valueMigration.reason: Verified business Value Migration: Acutaas is expanding from pharmaceutical intermediates into higher-value CDMO, semiconductor chemicals and battery chemicals. The company states that it is India's only manufacturer of semiconductor-grade photoresist chemicals and the first company in India outside China to develop electrolyte additives on a commercial scale. This indicates localisation/import-substitution and a shift toward higher-value new-age specialty chemistry.
